lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Uganda to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC classification zones were compiled for February, June, and October 2017, with spatial boundaries and classification values indicating the severity and extent of food insecurity across administrative units.
